output.reason: I find this convincing. It compares flag-on users with the random holdout inside the same build, it shows 7.4.0 was already crashing before the flag ramp began, and it rules out a reporting artifact using a second, independent source. It also tells me clearly to hold the 7.4.0 rollout and fix the Pixelda crash. Two weak spots: it says the flag-on vs holdout gap is within noise without giving the sample sizes, and it says device mix and usage are the same across groups without showing the figures.
